# Diagnostic codes

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from src/ and apps/; do not edit. Meanings live in diagnostics.yaml. -->

This catalogue is for examiners reading `INFO.yaml` / `listing.yaml` and for
contributors adding a reader. After reading it you can tell, for any `code`
in a manifest, which source line emitted it, how bad it is, and what to do
about the evidence. Codes are stable kebab-case slugs (`Diagnostic::code`,
`include/omnitrace/core/Diagnostics.h`); the message beside them is
human text and may change. `scripts/gen_docs.py` extracts every
construction site (`diag(...)`, `{Severity::..., "code", ...}`, the
`kCode*` constants and the codes assigned to a variable before the call)
and joins them with `docs/reference/diagnostics.yaml`; `scripts/check_docs.py`
fails when either side is missing an entry.

Severity is the value as emitted (`info` / `warning` / `error`, the names
`INFO.yaml` uses). A code listed with two severities is emitted at both;
`where` names every site, `message` is the literal with runtime parts as `...`.

169 diagnostic codes, 16 status codes.

## Status codes

A `Status::fail` carries `"<code>: <detail>"` in `Status::error`. These are
not diagnostics on their own: they surface as the `message` of
`analyze-open-failed`, `analyze-walk-failed`, `analyze-sink-failed` and
`sink-io-error`, and as the CLI's error line.

| code | where | message | meaning | examiner action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `analyze-no-image` | `src/discovery/Recurse.cpp:1205` | image source is null | analyze() was called with a null Source (caller bug) | contributor error; the CLI never produces this |
| `analyze-no-out-dir` | `src/discovery/Recurse.cpp:1207` | extraction needs out_dir | extraction was requested without a case directory (caller bug) | contributor error; the CLI always passes --out |
| `sink-duplicate-path` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:664` | no free '~<n>' suffix for '...' | an entry's path already existed on disk; it was written with a ~N suffix (or no free suffix was left) | the filesystem has duplicate names or an earlier walk left files; listing.yaml has the host path |
| `sink-io-error` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:325`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:329`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:361` (+7 more) | mkdir '...': ... | a host write, mkdir or stat failed | check free space and permissions; the entry is truncated or missing |
| `sink-limit-bytes` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:203` | max_bytes ... reached | the run-wide max_bytes budget was reached; data truncated | re-run with a larger --max-bytes |
| `sink-limit-file-bytes` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:195`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:750`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:961` | max_file_bytes ... reached | an entry exceeded Limits::max_file_bytes; data truncated | contributor option; the file on disk is partial |
| `sink-limit-files` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:211` | max_files ... reached | Limits::max_files entries were already emitted | re-run with a larger --max-files |
| `sink-not-directory` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:335`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:482` | '...' exists and is not a directory | a path component exists on the host and is not a directory | use an empty case directory |
| `sink-protocol` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:699`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:747`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:776` (+5 more) | begin_file while '...' is still open | begin_file/write/entry called out of order (reader bug) | contributor error in the reader |
| `sink-root-invalid` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:291`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:294`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:298` (+5 more) | root path is empty or not valid UTF-8 | the case directory root is empty, not creatable or not a directory | fix the --out path |
| `sink-symlink-component` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:333`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:481` | '...' is a reparse point | a directory component on the host is a symlink or reparse point; refused | use a clean case directory; this guards against escaping the tree |
| `sink-unsafe-path` | `src/core/Sink.cpp:702`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:810`, `src/core/Sink.cpp:948` (+1 more) | ... ('...') | the entry path is absolute, contains .. or otherwise escapes the tree; refused | hostile or damaged filesystem; the entry name is in the message |
| `squashfs-bad-superblock` | `src/filesystems/squashfs/SquashfsReader.cpp:358`, `src/filesystems/squashfs/SquashfsReader.cpp:360`, `src/filesystems/squashfs/SquashfsReader.cpp:379` (+3 more) | fewer than 96 bytes | open() refused the superblock (size, magic, block_log, block_size or bytes_used) | the validator hit was not a usable filesystem; inspect by hand |
| `squashfs-metadata-corrupt` | `src/filesystems/squashfs/SquashfsReader.cpp:1362`, `src/filesystems/squashfs/SquashfsReader.cpp:1371` | root inode: ... | a metadata block or a structure inside it is unreadable; walk fails at the root, otherwise the entry is skipped | damaged or unsupported image; compare with unsquashfs |
| `squashfs-root-invalid` | `src/filesystems/squashfs/SquashfsReader.cpp:1367` | root inode is not a directory | root_inode is not a directory; the walk fails | damaged superblock; nothing was extracted |
